title: 第十五章 压胜
slug: 剑来全本免费-剑来最新章节列表
content_zh:
生长于乡间野水，好似带着一股青草香的少女，与那些高檐大宅、庭院深深的大家闺秀，做派到底是不一样的。
她在见到草鞋少年后，没有像以往那般低敛眉眼，微微加快步伐侧身而过，反而停下了脚步，凝视着这个不经常打交道的邻居，欲言又止。
陈平安对她笑了笑，小跑着擦肩而过，然后跑得越来越快。
稚圭安安静静站在泥瓶巷口子上，转头望去，阳光下奔跑的寒酸少年，挺像一只生命力顽强的野猫，四处流窜，长得不咋样，但好像也饿不死。
少女在小镇上并不讨喜，受累于少年宋集薪的性情古怪，被取名稚圭的丫鬟不管是去铁锁井打水，还是赶集买东西，或是给自己少年添置文房用品，少女总给人一种不合群的感觉，也没有什么同龄人的玩伴，遇上熟人从来不爱多说话，对于偏好热闹喜庆的小镇百姓而言，这样的少女，实在是很难亲近起来。
在这方面，陈平安的境况和婢女稚圭，其实有些相似，不同的是少年虽然也不爱说话，但其实本身性格，绝对不惹人厌，相反，少年生性温和友善，从来没有什么刺人的锋芒，只是家境败落的关系，又早早去了龙窑烧瓷讨生计，才显得和邻里之间关系没有那么熟络。当然，泥瓶巷的街坊们，对于少年的生日，确实会有一些说不清道不明的忌惮，五月初五，在小镇乡俗里，属于五毒并出的“恶日”，少年在这一天出生，加上他爹娘的纷纷去世，陈平安早早成了家里最后一根独苗，自然而然会让人心里头犯嘀咕，尤其是上了岁数、喜欢在老槐树那边凑热闹的老人，对于这位泥瓶巷的少年，尤为疏远，私下也会告诫自家孩子不要接近，但是每当孩子满脸不情愿，刨根问底问为什么的时候，老人们就说不出个所以然了。
此时一个修长身形从小巷走出，站在少女身边，婢女稚圭转过头，一言不发，只是向前走。那人便转身与她并肩走在泥瓶巷里，正是学塾先生齐静春，小镇唯一的读书人，正儿八经的儒家门生。
少女脚步不停，脸色冷漠，“我们两个，井水不犯河水，不好吗？而且先生你别忘了，之前确实是你占据天时地利人和，我一个小小的贱籍奴婢，当然只能忍气吞声，但是从最近开始，先生你那座远在不知几千万里外的法脉道场，好像出了点问题，对吧？所以现在如今先生只是井水，而我才是河水！”
泥瓶巷的不速之客，齐先生微微一笑，道：“王朱，罢了，暂且入乡随俗喊你稚圭便是，稚圭，你有没有想过，你虽是天地眷顾，应运而生，可是当真以为我没有压胜的手段？还是说你觉得几千年前，四位神龙见首不见尾的圣人，联袂莅临此地，亲自订立规矩，只是嘴上说说而已，没有留下半点后手？说到底，你只是坐井观天罢了，苍穹之高，大地广袤，远远不是井口那点光景模样啊。”
少女皱了皱眉头，“齐先生，你也莫要拿话来唬我，我不是我家少爷宋集薪，对你那套冠冕堂皇的说辞，不感兴趣，也从来不信。先生不妨中年儒士缓缓道：“劝你脱离此处樊笼后，以后不要得寸进尺，涸泽而渔，无论对谁都没有好处。尤其是你和他踏上修行大道之后，不管是否结为道侣，都应当收敛锐气，不可跋扈恣睢。这并非是什么威胁，而是离别之际，我的一些肺腑之言，也算是善意的提醒。”
照理说两人身份天壤之别，婢女稚圭却极为不卑不亢，甚至当下气势还要隐约压过儒士半头，讥笑道：“善意？数千年来，你们这些了不得的修行中人，高高在上，画地为牢，拿此地作为一块庄稼地，今年割一茬明年拔一捆，年复一年，千年不变，怎么到了现在，才开始想起要与我这孽障‘与人为善’了，哈哈，我听少爷说过一句话，被你们很多人奉为圭臬，叫做非我族类，其心必异，对吧？所以说也怪不得齐先生，毕竟……”
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢剑来请大家
content_en:
The girl who grew up in the wild waters of the country and smelled like green grass had a completely different style from the ladies who lived in big houses with high eaves and deep courtyards.
After seeing the boy in straw sandals, she did not lower her eyebrows as before, speed up her pace slightly and pass by sideways. Instead, she stopped and stared at this neighbor who she did not often interact with, and hesitated to speak.
Chen Pingan smiled at her, passed her by at a trot, and then ran faster and faster.
Zhi Gui An stood quietly at the entrance of the Mud Bottle Alley, turning around to look at the shabby young man running in the sun. He looked like a tenacious wild cat, running around. He didn't look very good, but he seemed to be hungry.
The girl was not popular in the town. Due to the eccentric temperament of the young boy Song Jixin, the maid named Zhigui, whether she was going to the iron-locked well to fetch water, going to the market to buy things, or buying supplies for her boy's study, the girl always gave people a feeling of being out of place, and she had few playmates of the same age. She never liked to talk much when meeting acquaintances. For the people of the small town who preferred liveliness and celebration, it was really difficult to get close to such a girl.
In this regard, Chen Ping'an's situation is actually somewhat similar to that of the maid Zhigui. The difference is that although the boy doesn't like to talk, his personality is definitely not annoying. On the contrary, the boy is gentle and friendly by nature, and has never had any thorny edges. It is only because of his family's decline and that he went to the Long Kiln to make porcelain for a living early that he does not seem to have such a close relationship with his neighbors. Of course, the neighbors in Mud Ping Alley do have some unexplained fears about the boy's birthday. The fifth day of May is considered an "evil day" in the town's folk customs. The boy was born on this day, and his parents died one after another. Chen Ping'an became the last single child in the family early on. Naturally, It makes people murmur in their hearts, especially the elderly people who like to join in the fun at the old locust tree. They are particularly alienated from the young man in Mud Bottle Alley. They will privately warn their children not to get close to him, but whenever the children look reluctant and ask why, the old people can't explain the reason.
At this time, a slender figure walked out of the alley and stood beside the girl. The maid Zhigui turned her head and walked forward without saying a word. The man then turned around and walked side by side with her in the Clay Vase Alley. It was the school teacher Qi Jingchun, the only scholar in the town and a serious Confucian student.
The girl kept walking, with a cold face, "We two, the well water does not interfere with the river water, isn't it good? And sir, don't forget that you did occupy the right time, place and people before. I am a little humble slave, of course I can only swallow my anger, but from now on, sir, there seems to be something wrong with your Dharma lineage dojo tens of millions of miles away, right? So now, sir, you are just the water in the well, and I am the water in the river!"
Mr. Qi, the uninvited guest of Mu Ping Lane, smiled slightly and said: "Wang Zhu, that's all. For the time being, I will do as the locals do and call you Zhigui. Zhigui, have you ever thought that although you were born under the blessing of heaven and earth, do you really think that I don't have the means to defeat you? Or do you think that after thousands of years? Before, the four saints who had never seen the dragon came here together and made the rules themselves. They just talked about it and left no backup plan. In the end, you are just sitting in the well and looking at the sky. The sky is high and the earth is vast. It is far from the scene at the mouth of the well. "
The girl frowned and said, "Mr. Qi, don't try to bluff me with your words. I am not my young master Song Jixin. I am not interested in your high-sounding rhetoric and I have never believed it. Sir, you might as well say a middle-aged Confucian scholar slowly: "After you get out of the cage here, don't try to take advantage of the situation and fish in the lake. It will not benefit anyone. Especially after you and him embark on the road of spiritual practice, regardless of whether you become a Taoist couple or not, you should restrain your energy and not be domineering. This is not a threatIt is not a threat, but some of my heartfelt words before parting can be regarded as a kind reminder. "
Logically speaking, the status of the two people is very different, but the maid Zhigui is extremely neither humble nor arrogant, and even at the moment her momentum is vaguely more than half that of a Confucian scholar, she sneered and said: "Good intentions? For thousands of years, you, the incredible practitioners, have been standing high above us, drawing the ground as a prison, using this land as a crop field, cutting a crop this year and plucking a sheaf next year, year after year, thousands of years unchanged. How come it is only now that you start to remember to "be kind to others" with this evil obstacle like me? Haha, I heard the young master say something, which is regarded as a standard by many of you, and it is called people who are not my race, and their hearts must be different, right? So it’s no wonder Mr. Qi, after all..."
